title: Ports and Adapters

Fowler supports separating wiring from use; Martin's original Clean Architecture article supports the neighboring design and source dependency distinction. Official Python documentation supports Protocol and SQLite connection lifecycle details. The stock example and figures are original teaching material.

Output is reserved, then unavailable; the isolated script prints isolated checks passed.

example_limits: Local stock allocation only, not a complete order workflow. The adapter owns one transaction per call on a dedicated connection. The sequential memory substitute establishes neither database durability nor concurrent correctness. No remote retry or idempotency mechanism is implemented.
publication: Local implementation only. No publishing, deployment, push, or pull request.
